newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore residue stocks down, distillates mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore residue stocks down, distillates mixed.

text.p: Singapore residues stocks were down 99,000 barrels, to 10.59 million barrels for the week ending April 23, Singapore's Trade Development Board (TDB) statistics showed on Thursday.
They include HSFO, LSFO, LSWR and the straight-run atmospheric residue, but exclude bitumen.
Middle-distillate stocks rose 452,000 barrels to 7.038 million barrels.
Middle distillates comprise jet, kerosene and gas oil.
Light distillates stocks were down by 60,000 barrels to 7.543 million barrels.
Light distillate comprise gasoline, reformate and naphtha.
